title: Initialize instantsearch.js with a hierarchicalFacetsRefinements parameter

comments.body:
Hi @amelielescure sorry for the late reply, could you explain in term of UI/use case what you want to achieve? So that then we can see what's the best solution to achieve it.

Something like "I have a hierachical widget, I want category pages where one of the hierarchical facet is already selected". Or any other use case you have.

Thanks.

> I'm also looking for a command to filter the facets initially. I'm using disjunctive facet, how can a certain category selected by default? I tried facetFilter but it says in console not yet in current version.

Can you open a new issue and give the full JavaScript code you are using where you want to pre-select a facet filter? Also give the full error you are getting.

Thanks, it will help not hijack conversations and this particular issue. Once done I will remove the comments here
